name: lia-plugins
description: Lia Creative's Claude Code tooling. The home for everything the team installs to prototype and build — start with lia-tools for the build process, plus the prototyping pair.

plugins.name: lia-tools
plugins.description: For building lia.tools products — the toys, the toy box and the site — and the process that goes with them: writing epics, stories and tasks, the ready gate, pickup, orchestration, review and wrap-up. One install, one version.

plugins.name: squeaks
plugins.description: Scaffold and drive deliberately-rough, copy-first lo-fi prototypes. Describe an idea, get a clickable wireframe. Use when the thinking isn't finished yet.

plugins.name: design-and-refine
plugins.description: Generate distinct UI variations in an existing repo, compare side-by-side, collect feedback, and synthesize a refined version. Use for hi-fi work on real components.

plugins.name: ticket-builder
plugins.description: Superseded by lia-tools (which carries ticket-builder and its successors) — install that instead. This standalone stays until LIAB-924 retires it.
